title: Known-object test, TOI-5745.01
summary: Known-object test on TOI-5745.01: positive control on the catalogued transit(s), calibrated screen for further dips, catalogue cross-match. The null result excludes only dips deeper than that. Positive control: catalogued transit not recovered (1 covered epoch). Residual screen: 71 threshold entries outside the known-signal veto across 2 light curve(s), forming 34 distinct event(s), 0 persistent in SAP and PDCSAP at two or more baselines.
